statement: If n ≥ 2 follows the Juggler word O^7, then T^7(n) ≥ (n+1)^16. In particular the EEEE inverse cell [n^16, (n+1)^16) is empty of seven-odd images, so O^7 EEEE is not a cycle itinerary. Lean theorems o7_image_ge_succ_pow16 and no_cycle_itinerary_oooooooeeee in O7EEEEGap.lean. Proof: no_follows_seven_odds_of_lt256 excludes n < 256; on an O^7 run the exact cells x_k^3 < (x_{k+1}+1)^2 and x_k ≥ n compose to n^{6177} < (n+1)^{3990} (T^7(n)+1)^{128}; for n ≥ 256 one has n^{6177} > (n+1)^{6038} because 257^{256} < 3·256^{256} and 256^{139} > 2^{40} > 3^{24} > (257/256)^{6038}. This replaces the leftover 4-fudge (first fire at 828484409) by the exact successor cell. Not a length-11 census and not a halt theorem. Imported by JugglerPaper (Paper A Lemma 3.28).
